plainText:
Barron Bass is an American actor for the English-language dub of . He is currently affiliated with Abrams Artists in New York and In Both Ears in West Coast.

==Biography==
Bass was born in America and is based in New York. As an adult, he became a voice actor. Bass joined the during , gaining several roles with his most notable being that of Rose.

==Pokémon roles==
===Animation===
==== ====
Rose
Doug
Train Conductor (JN042)

==Other non-Pokémon roles==
Man (Luke Cage)
Nigel Anderson Cole (The Great Vanishing (I-III))
Malcolm X (Saving Malcolm)
Leroy Legend (Shampagne)
Macbeth (Bits of the Bard)
Isiah Mustafa Lookalike (Old Spice "Lingerer" Parody)
Marlon (New Heights)
Brian (Press Break)
Mike (I Don't Want A Boyfriend)
